convert_multiface_bin_to_meshtalk_obj: run the script to convert a multiface .bin geometry file into a meshtalk .obj mesh file
convert_geometry_with_custom_template: run the script with a custom --template_topology .obj file to convert multiface geometry to meshtalk format
filter_multiface_vertices: run the script to filter out ignored vertex indices from a multiface mesh and output a cleaned .obj file
merge_geometry_with_template_topology: run the script to merge multiface vertex geometry with a meshtalk template topology and save as .obj
validate_multiface_input_file: run the script to validate that the input multiface geometry is a .bin file before conversion
